title: Revising the plan for shared pleasure

captions.physics: Choosing fair conditions for shared enjoyment
captions.energy: Pursuing a complete ideal of leisure
captions.emotions: Experiencing an important wish become clear

meaning: Shared enjoyment gains a living form when a clarified wish permits the ideal plan to be shortened through fresh agreement.
text: Well agreed leisure can become more complicated than what you want now. Justice in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps choose fair conditions and include both preferences. The World in energy leans towards a complete picture with no part omitted. Judgement in emotions allows an important wish to become clear. That realisation may show that fullness lies in simple participation, beyond precisely executing every agreed item and condition prepared beforehand. A plan once chosen fairly can be reconsidered without losing respect for either person’s contribution.

For example, you planned a long evening with a game, dinner and a film, sharing preparation equally. Discussing it, you realise that unhurried conversation matters most. **A living wish can receive fair conditions afresh.** You can choose a simple dinner together and free the remaining time. The programme need not survive solely out of respect for assigned effort. Fairness remains when both freely choose the reduction, beyond a concealed concession at one person’s expense.

The difficulty is immediately demanding complete meaning from the simpler version. Conversation must now feel especially intimate or the shorter plan seems unjustified. Perfection has merely changed its outward form. Realisation supports pleasure as an invitation to experience. A small evening can matter without proving that you found the only correct way to relax and will never want anything different or more elaborate.
